from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

def calc_mw(seq_block):
    for block in seq_block.split(">")[1:]:
        header = block.split("\n")[0]
        seq = "".join(block.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
        pa = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
        mw = pa.molecular_weight()
        print(header[:30], len(seq), f"{mw:.2f} Da", f"{mw/1000:.3f} kDa")

import urllib.request

# Let's check NCBI Gene for SKA1 (GeneID: 55010) and ASB7 (GeneID: 140460)
def check_ncbi_proteins(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = requests.get(url).json()
    gene_id = req["esearchresult"]["idlist"][0]
    
    url2 = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&db=protein&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req2 = requests.get(url2).json()
    linkset = req2["linksets"][0]["linksetdbs"]
    protein_ids = []
    for ls in linkset:
        if ls["linkname"] == "gene_protein_refseq":
            protein_ids = ls["links"]
            break
    print(f"{gene_symbol} (Gene ID {gene_id}) RefSeq proteins:", protein_ids)
    
    if protein_ids:
        ids_str = ",".join(str(x) for x in protein_ids[:5])
        url3 = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={ids_str}&retmode=json"
        req3 = requests.get(url3).json()
        for pid in protein_ids[:5]:
            title = req3["result"][str(pid)]["title"]
            slen = req3["result"][str(pid)]["slen"]
            print(f"  {pid}: {title} (length: {slen})")

check_ncbi_proteins("SKA1")
